name: DesignApp
description: The Design app (vector and UI design): the SwiftUI App scene and views in Sources/DesignApp, built on SuiteUI's SuiteWindow and EditorDetail. Reads DesignModel and sends it intents through DesignWindow; never writes its state (scripts/ci app-state rule). Cut, Copy and Paste carry the Model's layer bytes on the system pasteboard (DesignPasteboardBridge).

relationships.description: builds its window from SuiteUI components
reads state and calls its methods
adds .suiteApp(_:) and the shared menus; records recents
receives hand-offs and routed documents; sends settings and switch requests (hand-off files, distributed notifications)
